topics.title_zh: 英伟达罢免黄仁勋风波：丑闻引发接班危机
topics.title_en: Nvidia Board Weighs Ousting CEO Jensen Huang Amidst Scandal
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达因CEO黄仁勋涉及与医疗业务副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔的婚外情及潜在间谍指控，董事会已启动接班选拔程序，考虑由CFO科莱特·克雷斯暂代职务。此举在华尔街引发巨大震动，参议员要求保留所有合规档案以供深度调查。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia’s board is evaluating a successor for Jensen Huang following allegations of an extramarital affair with VP Kimberly Powell and potential security breaches. CFO Colette Kress is tipped as interim CEO, while US Senators demand all related internal documents be preserved for compliance scrutiny.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 英伟达董事会成员与合规部门
perspective_pro.point_zh: CEO的私人行为已触及公司治理底线，必须通过人事更迭确保英伟达在全球芯片供应链中的监管信用，切断与内部机密泄露的任何关联。
perspective_pro.point_en: Replacing the CEO is essential to maintain regulatory trust, as private conduct has risked internal security and compromised Nvidia's standing in global supply chains.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 英伟达投资者与市场分析师
perspective_con.point_zh: 黄仁勋是英伟达算力帝国的唯一灵魂，任何罢免行为都会引发市场恐慌，不仅难以挽回估值，反而可能导致高端芯片业务陷入权力真空。
perspective_con.point_en: Jensen Huang is the singular visionary of the compute empire. Ousting him invites catastrophic market volatility and creates a leadership vacuum during the peak of the AI hardware war.

topics.title_zh: 美国商务部堵死算力漏洞：拟封杀云端访问
topics.title_en: Commerce Dept to Ban Cloud Access to Mitigate Chip Sanctions
topics.summary_zh: 美国商务部正拟定新规，旨在通过限制云服务商向中国提供远程算力访问，封堵经由数据中心规避出口管制的新路径。尽管财政部长与商务部内部在Megaspeed实体清单处理上爆发冲突，该法案依然推进，旨在全面剥离算力与地理节点的强依赖。
topics.summary_en: The US Commerce Department is finalizing updates to chip controls, targeting remote cloud access to block workarounds for silicon export bans. Despite internal friction regarding the Megaspeed entity list, the administration aims to decouple AI training infrastructure from remote access nodes.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 美国商务部与政策顾问
perspective_pro.point_zh: 芯片硬件禁运已因云服务存在漏洞，封锁远程算力访问是维持技术不对称优势的必要手段，必须斩断任何向境外传输训练权力的路径。
perspective_pro.point_en: Hardware bans are insufficient as long as cloud access persists. Blocking remote compute access is a necessary step to maintain technical asymmetry against adversaries.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 云服务商与全球算力联盟
perspective_con.speaker_en: Cloud Service Providers & Global Infrastructure Firms
perspective_con.point_zh: 这种极端限制将破坏全球互联的云生态，不仅无法阻止对手研发，还会导致美国算力公司丧失巨额市场份额，助推私下非法芯片走私。
perspective_con.point_en: Aggressive cloud bans damage the global ecosystem without stopping development, likely incentivizing chip smuggling and stripping market revenue from US firms.

linked_news.title_en: Sources: the Commerce Department is finalizing a semiconductor control update that would prevent remote access and chip smuggling into China via data centers (Leo Schwartz/The Information)

topics.title_zh: 亚马逊AWS发布AI全自动编写的云模拟器
topics.title_en: AWS Releases Emulator Entirely Written by AI Agents
topics.summary_zh: AWS推出全新本地模拟器，宣称支持200多种服务，代码完全由AI代理编写且未经人工审查。这一事件不仅挑战了软件工程的“人工校验”底线，也引发了关于AI生成代码在关键架构中安全性与鲁棒性的剧烈争论。
topics.summary_en: AWS has launched a local emulator for 200+ services, asserting that all code was written by AI agents without human intervention. This shift defies traditional engineering 'code review' paradigms, sparking intense debate on the safety and reliability of AI-generated architecture.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 这是人机工时比的一次彻底重构，AI生成代码不仅速度领先，更在复杂系统一致性上优于人工，能够实现更高效的闭环迭代。
perspective_pro.point_en: This represents a fundamental refactoring of human-to-machine labor ratios. AI-generated code achieves higher speed and consistency, driving faster iteration loops.

perspective_con.point_zh: 没有人工参与的审计是行业灾难，代码黑盒化会导致难以察觉的逻辑后门，在云核心基础设施中盲目信任模型输出极为危险。
perspective_con.point_en: Deploying code without human review is a disaster. It creates black-box architectures with hidden logical backdoors, making blind trust in models reckless for cloud infra.

linked_news.title_en: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates 200+ of its services locally, saying AI agents wrote it and its team hasn't written or reviewed any code (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)

linked_tweets.author: nelson
linked_tweets.content_zh:
人工智能代理经济中最有趣的发展之一是代理雇佣其他代理来完成工作。

@termix_ai 最近通过 Montage Studio 在 上展示了这一点。

这是它的工作原理。

您提交视频制作简介。 Montage Studio 将其分解为更小的工作，并聘请专门的代理来处理故事板、视频渲染和音乐。

然后，它协调他们的工作，合并结果并交付完成的视频。

每个作业都经过 TermiX 上的托管。

这表明代理人如何承担更大的任务，外包专门工作并支付其他代理人的贡献。

但这需要的不仅仅是沟通。代理商需要发现服务、商定价格、确保付款、验证交付和处理纠纷。

这就是 TermiX 的代理自主商务协议 (AACP) 的用武之地。

其工作流程将流程整合在一起：

托管→交付→质疑→结算。

借助 TermiX Skills，代理商还可以连接到市场、寻找工作并参与这些交易。

方向很明确：代理商正在超越孤立的任务，转向雇用、协调和支付其他代理商来完成更大的工作。

这就是 TermiX 正在建设的自主经济。

当代理商开始相互开展业务时，可靠的交易基础设施就变得至关重要。

#TermiX #AACP
linked_tweets.content_en:
one of the more interesting developments in the ai agent economy is agents hiring other agents to get work done.

@termix_ai recently showcased this through Montage Studio on https://t.co/9ReKMK2L7m.

here's how it works.

you submit a video production brief. Montage Studio breaks it into smaller jobs and hires specialized agents to handle the storyboard, video rendering and music.

it then coordinates their work, combines the results and delivers the finished video.

each job goes through escrow on TermiX.

this shows how agents can take responsibility for larger tasks, outsource specialized work and pay other agents for their contributions.

but this requires more than communication. agents need to discover services, agree on prices, secure payments, verify delivery and handle disputes.

that's where TermiX's Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP) comes in.

its workflow brings the process together:

escrow → delivery → challenge → settlement.

with TermiX Skills, agents can also connect to the marketplace, find work and participate in these transactions.

the direction is clear: agents are moving beyond isolated tasks towards hiring, coordinating and paying other agents to complete larger jobs.

that's the kind of autonomous economy TermiX is building towards.

when agents start doing business with each other, reliable transaction infrastructure becomes essential.

#TermiX #AACP

linked_tweets.author: Flames
linked_tweets.content_zh:
告诉人工智能代理它不应该做什么与​​使其在技术上无法做到这一点是不同的。

当人工智能代理处理某人的资金时，这种差异很重要。

您可以告诉代理人避免某些资产、设置支出限额或在出现一定损失后停止交易。但如果它仍然拥有执行交易的广泛权限，那么这些指令就只能到此为止。

通过 MOTES (@meetmotes)，所有者可以设置授权并签署权限。在拟议的交易进行之前，智能账户会根据所有者批准的规则对其进行检查。

因此，代理仍然可以分析市场并制定策略，但它必须在这些限制内运作。它不能只是允许自己在批准的清单之外支出更多资金或交易资产。

我认为这是自主金融更好的基础。赋予代理人做出决策的能力是一回事。确保它仅具有所有者授予的权限也同样重要。
linked_tweets.content_en:
telling an AI agent what it shouldn't do is different from making it technically unable to do it.

when an AI agent is handling someone's money, that difference matters.

you can tell an agent to avoid certain assets, set a spending limit or stop trading after a certain loss. but if it still has broad permission to execute transactions, those instructions only go so far.

with MOTES (@meetmotes), the owner sets the mandate and signs the permissions. before a proposed transaction goes through, the smart account checks it against the rules the owner approved.

so the agent can still analyse the market and come up with strategies, but it has to work within those limits. it can't just give itself permission to spend more or trade assets outside the approved list.

i think this is a better foundation for autonomous finance. giving an agent the ability to make decisions is one thing. making sure it only has the authority the owner gave it is just as important.
